summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed L70 life data, we can’t be sure the lights will last as expected before noticeable dimming.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Warranty
findings.detail: Warranty Period for LED Luminaires, including LED modules, LED boards, chips, and drivers: Five (5) years from date of Preliminary Acceptance.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing warranty proof leaves us unprotected if the fixtures fail early after installation.

findings.title: Specify option: DLC listing
findings.detail: DLC listing meets the spec only with DesignLights Consortium® (DLC) Premium qualified product and DLC qualified product. Not all versions of this product may be DLC Premium qualified or DLC qualified. Please check the DLC Qualified Products List at www.designlights.org/QPL to confirm which versions are qualified. (DLC Premium qualified product, DLC qualified product). Confirm the order specifies it.
findings.why_it_matters: If the product isn’t DLC qualified, we may lose energy rebates or fail to meet project efficiency goals.

compare.right_value: DLC Premium qualified product, DLC qualified product with DesignLights Consortium® (DLC) Premium qualified product and DLC qualified product. Not all versions of this product may be DLC Premium qualified or DLC qualified. Please check the DLC Qualified Products List at www.designlights.org/QPL to confirm which versions are qualified.

configure.option: DesignLights Consortium® (DLC) Premium qualified product and DLC qualified product. Not all versions of this product may be DLC Premium qualified or DLC qualified. Please check the DLC Qualified Products List at www.designlights.org/QPL to confirm which versions are qualified.
configure.value: DLC Premium qualified product, DLC qualified product
configure.quote: DesignLights Consortium® (DLC) Premium qualified product and DLC qualified product. Not all versions of this product may be DLC Premium qualified or DLC qualified. Please check the DLC Qualified Products List at www.designlights.org/QPL to confirm which versions are qualified.

findings.title: Specify option: macadam steps
findings.detail: macadam steps meets the spec only with Color Variation within 3-step MacAdam ellipse (3SDCM). (3). Confirm the order specifies it.
findings.why_it_matters: Color consistency matters—without 3-step MacAdam control, fixture colors may noticeably differ across rooms.

compare.right_value: 3 with Color Variation within 3-step MacAdam ellipse (3SDCM).

findings.title: Option not confirmed: Dims down to
findings.detail: Quoted values apply only to Non-Configurable BLT, each fixture will individually dim down to 10% brightness.. Confirm the submitted configuration.
findings.why_it_matters: We need to verify the dimming range to ensure the lights work properly with our lighting controls.

findings.title: Different revision found; no quoted values changed
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 07/18/24, web source Rev. 08/14/25. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Just because a document has a newer date doesn’t mean it’s the correct or approved version—we need clarity on which one governs.
